runners_data.name: Virtue Patience
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong Polytrack record faces tactical disadvantage from wide draw and crowded field
runners_data.comment: 3lb lower than when not beaten far over C&D in January; set to go well back on the AW
runners_data.spotlight: Better record on Polytrack than turf and the handicapper's given him every chance, with him now 3lb lower than when not beaten far as favourite over C&D in January; looks set to go well back on the AW.

runners_data.name: Pitney
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up type needs significant pace collapse to overcome 10 similar rivals from the rear
runners_data.comment: Consistent off a sliding mark during the winter; needs more if he's to snap the losing run
runners_data.spotlight: Rated much higher when joining this yard in autumn 2024; remained consistent enough off a sliding mark during the winter but needs more if he's to snap the losing run.

runners_data.name: Searchingtheblues
runners_data.note: Apprentice jockey claim valuable but hold-up style puts her at mercy of pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Won on Polytrack before and has been offering more of late; capable at this level
runners_data.spotlight: Won her first two as a 2yo and entered handicaps on an unrealistic mark; best efforts of late have come on Tapeta but she's won on Polytrack and has been offering more of late; capable at this level.

runners_data.name: Amber Honey
runners_data.note: 54-day break and hold-up style create double disadvantage in likely tactical race
runners_data.comment: Become hard to predict and there's no sign of the usual headgear for her new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Hold-up filly whose win for Ed Dunlop, from whom she was picked up in April for 7,500gns, came on Tapeta; become hard to predict and there's no sign of the usual headgear back from a short break.

runners_data.name: Mbappe
runners_data.note: 117-day layoff concern but proven course winner with hold-up style that needs good pace
runners_data.comment: Below-par in first-time cheekpieces (retained) when last seen; remains on a workable mark
runners_data.spotlight: Two turf wins here and two Polytrack victories at Kempton, latterly off 3lb lower in January; below-par in first-time cheekpieces (retained) when last seen four months ago (won fresh before) but remains on a workable mark.

runners_data.name: Play Me
runners_data.note: Better suited by stronger pace but 7lb claimer provides weight relief in competitive heat
runners_data.comment: Fair comeback over C&D behind Buy The Dip in April; didn't build on it back on turf latest
runners_data.spotlight: Epsom winner last August for regular partner Donagh Murphy off a 5lb lower mark; fair comeback over C&D behind Buy The Dip in April (6lb better off today) but didn't build on that back on turf a fortnight ago.

runners_data.name: Volto Di Medusa
runners_data.note: Rossa Ryan booking positive but hold-up style faces traffic problems in large field
runners_data.comment: Not always looked straightforward; interesting to see whether support comes this time
runners_data.spotlight: Tapeta win last summer came off this mark and the booking of Rossa Ryan is a positive as he returns to the AW after three ordinary efforts on turf; not always looked straightforward and interesting to see whether support comes this time.

runners_data.name: Buy The Dip
runners_data.note: Course winner ideally placed to track pace-setter and has form edge over stable companion
runners_data.comment: Won on his C&D comeback in April; this is more his speed back down 2lb; claims
runners_data.spotlight: Well suited by switchback tracks and took advantage of a handy mark when winning on his C&D comeback in April; found life tougher off his revised mark in better company here last time but this is more his speed back down 2lb.

runners_data.name: Secret Road
runners_data.note: Veteran's experience valuable but 32-day break and hold-up style create questions
runners_data.comment: Well behind a couple of these over C&D a month ago; needs more from somewhere
runners_data.spotlight: Enjoyed a revival for James Owen and this yard earlier in the year, with three wins, including two round here; up in the weights now, though, and finished well behind a couple of these over C&D a month ago; needs more from somewhere.

runners_data.name: Showmedemoney
runners_data.note: Blinkers back on after wins gives clear tactical advantage as likely lone pace-setter
runners_data.comment: Again no sign of the tongue-tie; big price and well held for new yard on turf last time
runners_data.spotlight: Goes back to the blinkers worn for both Newcastle wins, latterly off 3lb lower, for Iain Jardine in the winter but again no sign of the usual tongue-tie; big price and well held for his new yard on turf a few weeks ago.

runners_data.name: Victory Sound
runners_data.note: Sliding handicap mark creates opportunity but hold-up style needs everything to fall right
runners_data.comment: Handicapper quick to ease off and it wouldn't be the biggest shock were he to pop up
runners_data.spotlight: Useful 2yo for Charles Hills who struggled badly during a limited campaign last season; handicapper quick to ease off and it wouldn't be the biggest shock were he to pop up for a yard also responsible for Searchingtheblues.

runners_data.name: Dios De La Guerra
runners_data.note: 181-day absence huge negative despite first-time headgear and prominent racing style
runners_data.comment: Regressive maiden; first-time headgear has to make a difference back from six months off
runners_data.spotlight: Regressive maiden who had breaks between his three handicaps runs last year (beaten a long way each time); the first-time headgear will need to be a difference maker back from six months off.

races.paceDynamic: Showmedemoney and Dios De La Guerra are the only two with prominent/pace-setting tendencies, with Showmedemoney the more confirmed front runner who should dictate terms early. With 10 confirmed hold-up horses, the early pace will be comfortable rather than contested, allowing Showmedemoney to bowl along at his own rhythm. The large field of hold-up horses will create a cavalry charge in the final two furlongs, but the sustainable early pace means those positioned handy or able to track the leaders will have a significant tactical advantage over horses coming from the rear.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Handy Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Showmedemoney sets steady fractions and one horse tracks him closely
scenarios.body: The pace-setter weakens late but his tracker has saved energy while avoiding the traffic problems that will engulf the back markers. Hold-up horses at the rear struggle to make ground through the congested field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Showmedemoney gets soft fractions and stays strong
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the pace-setter to conserve energy for a sustained finish, holding off the late charge. His Newcastle wins prove he can lead all the way when getting his own way early.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is very slow and the field stays bunched
scenarios.body: The gentle gallop allows the strongest stayers among the hold-up horses to unleash devastating finishing kicks. Class and raw ability overcome tactical disadvantage when the race becomes a pure sprint finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Showmedemoney goes too slowly and gets swamped early
scenarios.body: The front runner gets headed before halfway, creating a messy scramble with no clear pace anchor. The race becomes a lottery with moderate horses getting first run on the leaders.

watchPoints.text: Showmedemoney's early fractions will determine the entire race outcome - soft pace favors him, strong pace sets up closers
Buy The Dip's position tracking the leader in the first half-mile as he has proven course form and tactical advantage
Traffic problems developing in the back half of the field where 8-10 hold-up horses will be clustered
Virtue Patience's ability to secure early cover given his wide draw and need to be handy in this pace setup
Victory Sound for market support given his sliding mark and trainer's recent winner from small string

runners_data.name: Southbank
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong C&D form who was unlucky in traffic last time and suits this tactical setup
runners_data.comment: Unlucky back on turf last time, when hitting plenty of traffic; will rightly be popular
runners_data.spotlight: Nothing wrong with his C&D second a month ago and was unlucky back on turf last time (same Bath handicap he won last season), when hitting plenty of traffic; will rightly be popular.

runners_data.name: Jackson Street
runners_data.comment: Regressive gelding; be happier back on Polytrack should they go hard in front
runners_data.spotlight: Regressive gelding who's having his first run in a sprint since this time last year and is drawn widest; well held back from a break on turf here a fortnight ago (7f) but will be happier back on Polytrack should they go hard in front.

runners_data.name: Chasing Gold
runners_data.comment: Reared as the stalls opened on turf comeback and unseated; can only be considered risky
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden who's had his moments at the start and often pulled hard; reared as the stalls opened on his turf comeback and unseated, so can only be considered risky in first-time blinkers.

runners_data.name: Tomarlo
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse switching yards who was well-backed but disappointed over shorter trip last month
runners_data.comment: Well backed for new yard latest, when things didn't pan out his way; on an attractive mark
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish gelding who struggled in three runs early in the year for Barry Brennan; well backed for his new yard on Tapeta early last month, when things didn't pan out his way, and is on an attractive mark currently; shortlisted.

runners_data.name: Walking On Clouds
runners_data.comment: Slid to a competitive mark for his current yard; one to consider back in headgear
runners_data.spotlight: Missed a chunk of last year and has slid to a competitive mark for his current yard; just behind Southbank over C&D a month ago and is one to consider back in headgear (second-time blinkers).

runners_data.name: Ashford Hill
runners_data.comment: In a sprint for just the second time; whether she'll have the toe round here the question
runners_data.spotlight: Winner here early in the year who's been held a few times since; running in a sprint for just the second time and, for all that she's a keen-goer, whether she'll have the required toe round here is the question.

runners_data.name: Griselda
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with finishing concerns who switches from cheekpieces to first-time visor
runners_data.comment: Regressive and inconsistent; has to bounce back from a couple of ordinary efforts on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Regressive and inconsistent for this yard, and is tried in a first-time visor instead of cheekpieces tonight; needs to bounce back from a couple of ordinary efforts on turf.

runners_data.name: Top Star
runners_data.comment: Longstanding maiden who missed a chunk of his career; tried without headgear today
runners_data.spotlight: Longstanding maiden who missed a chunk of his career; tried in three forms of headgear this year, including when fourth behind two of these over C&D a month ago, and is given another try without today.

runners_data.name: Poetic Jack
runners_data.comment: Pulled hard when well behind three of these as favourite over C&D a month ago
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled hard when well behind three of these as favourite over C&D a month ago; another poor one on turf since tempers enthusiasm.

runners_data.name: Dreamcrafter
runners_data.note: Prominent horse returning after 284 days off with little previous achievement to recommend
runners_data.comment: Achieved little in a handful of starts last year; hard to fancy returning from an absence
runners_data.spotlight: Achieved little in a handful of starts last year (5f-7f) and is hard to fancy returning from a lengthy absence.

races.paceDynamic: Poetic Jack is the only confirmed front runner but pulled hard and disappointed as favourite over C&D last month, suggesting he may not lead with conviction. With nine hold-up horses behind him, this creates a pedestrian early pace unless Dreamcrafter shows more pace after 284 days off. The lack of pace pressure will create a sprint finish where positioning and turn of foot matter most. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses with tactical speed who can quicken from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Poetic Jack leads uncontested and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates a cavalry charge finish where horses with the best turn of foot prevail. Hold-up horses like Southbank and Walking On Clouds benefit most from being able to unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Modest Pace Suits Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If Dreamcrafter or another horse joins Poetic Jack early to create moderate fractions
scenarios.body: A steady but not crawling pace allows prominent racers to position handy and kick clear before the hold-up brigade gets organized. This benefits horses comfortable sitting just off the lead.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Problems Decide
scenarios.trigger: If the large field of hold-up horses creates a wall of horses turning for home
scenarios.body: Multiple runners get blocked or forced wide in the straight, allowing those with clear runs to capitalize. Luck in running becomes the primary factor rather than pure ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Surprises
scenarios.trigger: If Poetic Jack learns from his disappointing last run and sets sensible fractions under Ray Dawson
scenarios.body: A more controlled tempo allows the leader to see out the trip better than expected. The hold-up horses are left with too much ground to make up in the final furlong.

watchPoints.text: Chasing_Gold reared as stalls opened last time and unseated his rider, making him a non-runner risk
Poetic_Jack must settle better than his last run when he pulled hard and disappointed as favourite
Jackson_Street is drawn in stall 10 and will need luck from the outside draw with his hold-up style
Walking_On_Clouds has dropped to a competitive mark and finished close behind Southbank last time
Dreamcrafter returns after 284 days off and showed little ability in his previous career

runners_data.name: Starship Trooper
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 61 days whose Kempton form ties in well with Parisian Scholar, giving him a realistic chance if positioned close enough.
runners_data.comment: Has shown ability, but might not come into his own until contesting a strongly run race
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown ability and was only just behind Parisian Scholar when fourth of five on handicap debut at Kempton (1m3f, Polytrack) in April; might not come into his own until contesting a strongly run race in a bigger field, though.

runners_data.name: Astrological
runners_data.note: Showed promise at Wolverhampton but steps up significantly in class and distance, with the 3lb claimer potentially a concern.
runners_data.comment: Second and first in two starts at Wolverhampton; longer trip shouldn't be an issue
runners_data.spotlight: Both starts at Wolverhampton (9.5f, Tapeta), finishing second of five on debut in March before landing odds of 1-2 the following month; that latest form hasn't worked out, but he remains unexposed and the longer trip shouldn't be an issue on this handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Charles Darnay
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 91-day break whose style is poorly suited to likely uncontested pace scenario.
runners_data.comment: Off the months since winning at Kempton, but that form has been franked; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Built on earlier promise upped in trip when off the mark in a Kempton maiden (1m4f, Polytrack) in March; off three months and this easier track may not be ideal, but the three immediately behind him at Kempton have all won since; respected on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Parisian Scholar
runners_data.note: Front-runner with proven 1m handicap wins who faces no early pace pressure and carries headgear for the first time.
runners_data.comment: Twice placed at Kempton earlier this year, but may be vulnerable to an improver; visor on
runners_data.spotlight: Front-runner who landed three 1m handicaps last autumn, the last two at Newcastle (Tapeta); twice placed off 2lb higher at Kempton (1m3f, Polytrack) earlier this year, but may be vulnerable to an improver; visor replaces cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Wardlaw
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who has been gelded since last disappointing runs but needs significant improvement to compete at this level.
runners_data.comment: One-paced on handicap debut at Windsor a fortnight ago, but could improve; cheekpieces on
runners_data.spotlight: Fourth of 13 behind Talk Of New York on his third start at Kempton (1m, Polytrack) last October, but having been gelded he looked one-paced when fifth of seven on handicap/turf debut at Windsor (11.4f, good) a fortnight ago; needs to improve for the cheekpieces, but that is possible.

races.paceDynamic: Parisian Scholar will take the field along from the front with minimal pressure, as the only confirmed leader in this small field. Starship Trooper and Astrological may try to track him prominently, but both lack the early pace to challenge for the lead. With no genuine speed in behind, Parisian Scholar will dictate comfortable fractions throughout the 1m4f trip. This uncontested lead scenario heavily favors front-runners and those with tactical speed to position close, while hold-up horses like Charles Darnay face a significant disadvantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Parisian Scholar Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Parisian Scholar gets an uncontested lead and sustains his gallop
scenarios.body: The confirmed front-runner will face no early pressure and can rate himself perfectly through steady fractions, making full use of his tactical advantage. His recent Kempton form shows he handles similar conditions well when allowed to dominate.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If Starship Trooper or Astrological can get close enough to strike
scenarios.body: Either prominent runner could benefit from tracking the leader and having something left for a final challenge in the straight. Their similar ratings to Parisian Scholar give them a chance if they can get first run on the leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Charles Darnay can find gaps and the pace becomes strong enough
scenarios.body: The maiden winner would need the pace to collapse and clear running to utilize his finishing kick effectively. His 91-day break and preference for easier surfaces work against him here.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Wardlaw finds dramatic improvement post-gelding operation
scenarios.body: The Prescott runner would need to show vastly improved form from his recent disappointing efforts. His prominent style gives him some tactical hope but his recent form is poor.

watchPoints.text: Parisian Scholar getting an easy lead through the first half-mile will make him very difficult to peg back
Charles Darnay needs to be positioned much closer than usual given the likely lack of pace
Astrological stepping up markedly in trip and grade after two starts over shorter at Wolverhampton
Starship Trooper's 61-day break affecting his fitness levels in the closing stages
Wardlaw showing any signs of improvement following his gelding operation
